gen.appointment.data021:
1. Scheduling an appointment is to help the applicant to shorten the waiting time in the visa hall.

2. Appointments should be made in accordance with the requirements of the local Chinese Embassy/Consulate. If the Embassy/Consulate does not provide the appointment service, the applicant may submit the application in paper form directly at the Embassy/Consulate.

3. The appointment website is available 24 hours a day. There are no fees charged for making appointments online.

4. Please fill in the "Visa Application Form" online before making an appointment. When the online review is passed and the "Video interview to be scheduled" message is displayed, you may start making the appointment online.

5. You need to make your appointment in advance. Please follow the requirements of the local Chinese Embassy/Consulate on how far in advance you should make your appointment.

6. After an appointment is successfully made, the time of the appointment cannot be changed. If you need to make changes to the date or time of appointment, please cancel the appointment and make a new one via "My application - Application details - My appointment".

7. After an appointment is successfully made, you may check the appointment information at "My appointment" and print the appointment form.

8. If you are unable to show up on the day of the appointment, you need to cancel the appointment at least one working day in advance. Otherwise, it will be regarded as a failure to show up for the appointment, the appointment number will be annulled, and you will need to make a new appointment.

9. If an appointment is successfully made, the applicant should arrive at the local Chinese Embassy/Consulate at least 20 minutes ahead of the appointment time and bring the following documents: the passport, proof of the online appointment for Chinese visa application, and other required materials.

10. You may make the appointment for no more than 6 applications at a time, and all the applicants must visit the Embassy/Consulate at the same time.

11. The website supports Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox (version 54.0 or higher), and Safari (version 10.0.1 or higher).

12. Please fill in the form in Chinese or English.

gen.choiceCountry.noticeNotice6:
The Embassy/Consulate will make the decision on whether or not to grant the visa based on the result of the final review. Whether the visa is granted or not, your passport will be returned to you.

How do I collect my passport?

When you submit your passport, the staff of the Embassy/Consulate will tell you how to collect your passport later by visiting the Embassy/Consulate or by post.

Please follow your application status and collect your passport according to instructions on the "Collect Your Passport" page.
gen.choiceCountry.noticeNotice5:
You need to submit your passport by visiting the Embassy/Consulate or by post as required. Your fingerprints may be collected when you visit the Embassy/Consulate.

Does the applicant need to visit the Embassy/Consulate in person to submit the passport?

The applicant may be required to visit the Embassy/Consulate to submit the passport and have the fingerprints taken. Fingerprints of ten fingers will be collected for all applicants for Chinese visas, with the exception of those who are:

① under 14 years old or over 70 years old;

② heads of state or government and their accompanying family members;

③ qualified for a Chinese diplomatic visa, official visa, or courtesy visa (unless the reciprocity principle otherwise requires);

④ members of the staff of foreign diplomatic or consular missions in China and their spouses, parents, and minor children;

⑤ applicants for Chinese visas at the same Embassy/Consulate of China with the same passports and with fingerprints already taken within the past 5 years;

⑥ missing all ten fingers or unable to provide any of the ten fingerprints.

If you have entrusted someone to submit your passport, please confirm the application submission and fingerprint collection arrangements with the entrusted person.

Please track your application progress and follow the instructions on the "Submit Your Passport" page.

Check the result of the preliminary review: Once your application is submitted, the Embassy/Consulate may require you to provide additional materials at any time. Please track the progress of your application through the "Track My Application" page.

Revise your application form: If problems are found in your application form or materials, the Embassy/Consulate will return your application for revision. You can make relevant revisions or supplements through the "Track My Application" page.

Make an appointment for the next step: After passing the preliminary review, you need to make an appointment for a video interview or a visit to the Embassy/Consulate as required.
gen.choiceCountry.noticeNotice3:
First, you need to create an account in the China Online Visa Application System and sign in to the account to enter the visa application page.

Please fill out the application form correctly and completely before uploading the application materials as required. You may save a draft of the unfinished application form if you need to sign out during the process.

After filling out the application form and uploading the application materials, you need to make the visa fee payment. There is a separate page for visa fee payment and relevant instructions.

How far in advance should I apply for a visa?

You are advised to apply one month before your planned travel date, but no earlier than three months in advance. The application process may take longer in special cases.

May I cancel my application, and will my visa fee be refunded?

The visa application process is complicated, and normally you cannot cancel the visa application you have submitted. Even if you insist on canceling the application, all the visa fees already paid will not be refunded.

gen.visaformNotice.title: Guidelines for Filling in the China Online Visa Application (COVA) Form
gen.appointment.appointNote001:
1. Video interviews are provided for the applicants to have direct communication online with consular officers, in order to facilitate the Chinese visa application process.

2. Appointments should be made in accordance with the requirements of the local Chinese Embassy/Consulate. If the Embassy/Consulate does not provide the online appointment service, the applicant may submit the application in paper form directly at the Embassy/Consulate.

3. The appointment and inquiry website is available 24 hours a day. There are no fees charged for making appointments online.

4. Please fill in the "Visa Application Form" online before making an appointment. When the online review is passed and the "Video interview to be scheduled" message is displayed, you may start making the appointment online.

5. You need to make your appointment in advance. Please follow the requirements of the local Chinese Embassy/Consulate on how far in advance you should make your appointment.

6. After an appointment is successfully made, the time of the appointment cannot be changed. If you need to make changes to the date or time of appointment, please cancel the appointment and make a new one via "My application - Application details - My appointment".

7. After an appointment is successfully made, you may check the appointment information at "My appointment".

8. If you are unable to show up on the day of appointment, you need to cancel the appointment at least one working day in advance. Otherwise, it will be regarded as a failure to show up for the appointment, and the appointment No. will be annulled, and you will need to make a new appointment.

9. If an appointment is successfully made, the applicant should enter the video room at least 20 minutes ahead of the appointment time via "My application form --Application details -- My appointment" and wait for the call from the consular officer.

10. You may make an appointment for only one person at a time.

11. The website uses the Google Chrome browser.

12. Please make sure your camera and microphone are turned on for the video interview.

The Embassy/Consulate of China accepts visa applications made by:

The applicant must currently be in the territory of the Embassy/Consulate's residing country. Please make sure you submit the application in the country where you currently stay.

Each Chinese Embassy/Consulate has its own consular district. Please submit your application to the Embassy/Consulate in the consular district you reside in.

gen.visaformNotice.body:
(*)This website supports the following browsers: Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox (version 54.0 and higher), and Safari (version 10.0.1 and higher).

1. When filling in the application form, if you want to move to the next or previous page, please click the "Next" or "Previous" button at the bottom of the page, and do not use the forword or backword function of the brower.

2. Please fill in each column correctly. The items marked with "*" are mandatory. You have to answer all the mandatory questions on the page before proceeding to the next step. Some of these items have the option of [Not Applicable]. If a question does not apply to you, please tick "Not Applicable" to proceed.

3. If you have questions about the items in the COVA, you may click the "Help" button on the upper right corner to get help.

4. You may click the [Save] button to save an unfinished form, but the contents can only be kept for 30 days in the system. You can continue to fill in the unfinished form within 30 days by logging in to your account.

5. Please make sure the form is correctly completed before you click the "Submit" button. Once the application is submitted, you cannot make any changes.

6. After submitting the application, you need to upload the electronic version of the application materials, which should be clear and complete, as required by the relevant Chinese Embassy/Consulate.

7. The relevant Chinese Embassy/Consulate may require you to make an appointment for a video interview and subsequently make an appointment for a visit to the Chinese Embassy/Consulate to submit your passport. Please closely follow the status of your application.

8. Please fill in the form in Chinese or English.

9. The system only accepts visa applications for entry dates within the next 90 days. Applications submitted outside of this period will not be processed.

10. After the order is approved, please visit the visa center or embassy/consulate within 30 calendar days to apply for the visa, as the order will expire otherwise.

Notice: Submitting the COVA Form online does not mean that you will get the visa you have applied for. The final decision on the visa will be made by the Chinese Embassy/Consulate, which may be different from your application.
